story.iWant: check the installation status and versions of development environment dependencies
story.soThat: I can determine which components need to be installed or updated
story.tasks: - [ ] Task 1: Core Dependency Detection Engine (AC: 1, 2, 3) - [ ] Subtask 1.1: Create DependencyChecker class in core/dependency_checker.py - [ ] Subtask 1.2: Implement Node.js version detection and path verification - [ ] Subtask 1.3: Implement Python version detection and pip status check - [ ] Subtask 1.4: Implement Git toolchain detection and configuration check - [ ] Subtask 1.5: Add version comparison logic for minimum requirements - [ ] Task 2: Network Connectivity Validation (AC: 4) - [ ] Subtask 2.1: Create network status checker in utils/network_utils.py - [ ] Subtask 2.2: Test package manager accessibility (npm, pip, git repositories) - [ ] Subtask 2.3: Implement proxy detection and configuration validation - [ ] Subtask 2.4: Add offline mode detection capabilities - [ ] Task 3: Dependency Report Generation (AC: 5) - [ ] Subtask 3.1: Design dependency status data structure - [ ] Subtask 3.2: Create formatted report generator with missing components - [ ] Subtask 3.3: Implement user-friendly display with installation suggestions - [ ] Subtask 3.4: Add export functionality for dependency reports - [ ] Task 4: Integration and Testing - [ ] Subtask 4.1: Integrate with existing OperatingSystemDetector - [ ] Subtask 4.2: Create comprehensive unit tests for dependency checking - [ ] Subtask 4.3: Test on different environments with various dependency states - [ ] Subtask 4.4: Validate error handling for edge cases

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Check Node.js >= 16.0.0, record version number and installation path 2. Check Python >= 3.8, record version number and pip status 3. Check Git toolchain, verify git command availability 4. Check network connection status, determine if package managers are accessible 5. Generate dependency check report, display missing components list to users

tests.standards: 使用pytest框架进行单元测试，遵循已建立的测试模式。目标80%+测试覆盖率。使用mock验证外部工具调用和跨平台兼容性。测试文件命名模式：test_dependency_checker.py。测试应覆盖正常情况、异常情况和边界条件。
